note: Transferred 70,000 USDC to the lookalike recipient 0x0bfd0d71285dcf61262e4413ea32baaea7f1b2d2, surfaced through a compromised app interface. Although its execution was aggregated on-chain with other Safe transactions, the individual payload signed at nonce 157 is a plain call to USDC transfer: it invokes neither an approval function nor a Request contract. Filed upstream under unintended approvals, but the signed transaction is a transfer to the wrong address. Fails R-4.3: the recipient is outside the expected target set (§ 2.4).
